lead: Hello! I'm Samuel — a developer who loves turning complex problems into simple, beautiful, and intuitive solutions.
p2: My journey in tech started with curiosity and has grown into a deep passion for digital transformation and business intelligence. I specialize in building analytics platforms and modern web applications that combine solid engineering with thoughtful design.
